method.timeBase: performance.now() inside the page; click times are the browser's own event.timeStamp
method.visible: first requestAnimationFrame callback after the DOM change that carries the state
method.headless: headless Chromium; rAF cadence is a proxy for presented frames
method.thirdParty: no interception in this run: fonts/avatars are fetched live or fail, exactly as the app would
method.quantiles: nearest-rank, so every reported value is an observation that happened

compositorTickCeiling.note: headless Chromium is not vsync-locked to a display; the shortest interval observed is this browser's tick period, and no measurement here can exceed it

machineLoad.verdict: QUIET: no cargo/rustc build seen, and 1-minute load stayed under 0.35 per core
